resources.string: Regimens and intake history are shared. Taking a dose uses the selected cabinet. New cabinets start empty. Archive is allowed only for an empty cabinet; history is kept.
Cannot change this cabinet. To archive it, recount its stock to zero first and keep at least one active cabinet.
Stock belongs to the cabinet selected when this screen opened. Package strengths and regimens are shared.
This package still has stock in another cabinet. Keep the package, or recount its stock there to zero before removing it.
